-- intro: Legion Magic is a magic attribute that allows a user to create and manipulate magical soldiers.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to create and manipulate magical soldiers at will. In order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires. Pawn soldier.png|Pawn Rook soldier.png|Rook Knight soldier.png|Knight Fourth soldier.png The soldiers created by this magic resemble suits of armor shaped like chess pieces, and are much taller and larger than normal humans. These soldiers, filled with the user's magic power, are able to levitate and will carry out any task given to them until they run out of magic power. The user is also able to make a suit of armor for themself and remotely receive information from their soldiers. Additionally, the user can switch locations with any of their magical soldiers as a means to avoid an attack. If used correctly and by someone powerful, this magic potentially grants the user the equivalent military power of an entire country, allowing them to wage and fight an entire war all on their own. A multitude of soldiers could even merge into one gigantic soldier, or pile up together to form barricades and engulf opponents in sheer numbers.
-- spell pages: Gehenna Game; Endless Domination; Blink Castling; End Empress
